name: Zenith Dark Geyser
effects: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Dark 2 with Stacking], [Attach Earth 2 with Stacking] or [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking] if the entry damage was Dark/Earth/Wind, grants [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Emperor (Dark)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Dark 2 with Stacking], [Attach Earth 2 with Stacking] or [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking] if the entry damage was Dark/Earth/Wind, grants [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Emperor (Dark)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Emperor (Dark)
description.text: Increases [Earth/Wind/Dark Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Earth, Wind or Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Emperor (Dark) after using two Earth, Wind or Dark abilities (max 2), grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Starfall+
description.text: Three single attacks (3.60 each), causes [Imperil Dark 10% (5s)], [Imperil Earth 10% (5s)] and [Imperil Wind 10% (5s)]

description.name: Repentance Thorns+
description.text: Five single attacks (3.80/3.95 each), capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Attach Dark 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Attach Earth 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Attach Wind 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
